name: linear-ai
description: Linear issue intake, refinement, implementation and closeout, status and setup checks, review and reconciliation workflows for AI-assisted delivery, using Linear statuses as the workflow state.

interface.shortDescription: Create, inspect, refine, implement, batch, review, and close Linear issues.
interface.longDescription: Workflow skills for Linear-driven delivery: intake (technical and plain-language), refinement into an eleven-section issue template checked by a local validator, implementation in issue worktrees with bounded review rounds and verified closeout on main, status and setup checks with migration from v1, repository review into tickets, and reconciliation of issue-linked git work.
